transcript.repeated: courses: term, sourceCode, title, credits, grade, score, confidence
transcript.identification: Academic record with institution and academic/grade/course evidence; filename is not evidence

identity/passport.identification: Identity biographical document; passport requirement additionally requires passport subtype. Generic identity requirement accepts passport

immunization.identification: Patient and provider vaccination record; no inferred health compliance

financial_aid.identification: Financial verification worksheet or household income evidence

lifecycle.reset: requirement ready; active originals superseded; scoped work cancelled and cards archived
lifecycle.typeMatched: document needs_review; extraction pending_staff with empty fields; requirement under_review
lifecycle.staffParsing: staff command -> document processing -> completed extraction, needs_review / under_review (no approval)
lifecycle.wrongType: document rejected, requirement ready, immediate replacement allowed
lifecycle.unreadable: stored original retained with safe non-retryable parse error; replacement required
lifecycle.ambiguousOrIncomplete: original retained for staff review, no fabricated values
lifecycle.temporaryFailure: failed extraction, original retained, bounded retry on same document
lifecycle.staffEdit: expected task version + idempotency; canonical correction and before/after audit; realtime invalidation
lifecycle.staffApproval: separate authorized original-reviewed decision; updates requirement only after review
